bio.text: Chris Smith was first elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 1980 and represents New Jersey's 4th Congressional District.
He is a senior member of the Foreign Affairs Committee and chairs its Africa Subcommittee.
He was born in Rahway, grew up in Iselin, and lives in Manchester, New Jersey, with his wife Marie.
He graduated from Trenton State College, now The College of New Jersey, with a degree in business administration.
